messages.author: b949e0841d7e094b
messages.subject: online survey tool with shiny
parts:
My first shot at an online survey based on shiny app.

http://spark.rstudio.com/toche/demo-survey/
http://spark.rstudio.com/toche/demo-survey/ui.R
http://spark.rstudio.com/toche/demo-survey/server.R

Survey results are saved with a unique file name (actually perhaps not if two surveys are submitted at almost exactly the same time, may need to look into this more carefully). 

At this time the survey results are saved locally in the directory where the app resides. Perhaps it would be better practice to save them in a subdirectory. Also I need to figure out the best way to retrieve the files from the server for processing. Ultimately, a shiny app that would process the survey results would be nice.

Any comments welcome.

messages.subject: Re: online survey tool with shiny
parts: Very cool.  If you wrote the results to a database table rather than a file, then you could later query the DB and return a data frame for easy post-processing.  Something like RMySQL or RPostgreSQL.  Solves both of your problems at the same time, hopefully.
